The Excess God: Demon Chariots 5.0 bundle delivers a brutal and decadent vision of war at 10mm scale, featuring three distinct demon chariot models forged to embody speed, excess, and merciless destruction on the battlefield. Each chariot is designed with aggressive silhouettes, dynamic motion, and exaggerated details that remain crisp and readable even at small scale, making them ideal centerpieces for dark fantasy or infernal-themed armies.

Every model in this bundle is carefully optimized for high-quality resin printing. All miniatures come manually pre-supported using Lychee Slicer, with supports placed by hand to ensure reliable prints, minimal cleanup, and maximum preservation of fine details. The geometry is engineered to reduce unnecessary islands while maintaining structural strength, allowing for efficient and consistent printing across multiple copies.

These miniatures are created for miniature-agnostic tabletop games, giving players full freedom to use them across a wide range of custom systems and settings. They are not intended to replace, replicate, or act as proxies for any commercially licensed miniature ranges. For non-agnostic games, the use of original, officially licensed components is always recommended. Tordominis does not condone or support piracy in any form.

All distribution rights for these models are reserved exclusively by Tordominis. Official releases are available only through the Tordominis store on MyMiniFactory and through authorized physical miniature sellers. Any unauthorized sharing or distribution of these files, including via third-party websites, file-sharing platforms, or messaging services, is strictly prohibited.

This bundle is built for players and collectors seeking uncompromising detail, dark grandeur, and battlefield presence at epic scale.

From the twisted forges of the abyss rises the Excess God’s Demonic Infantry 5.0—reborn for the fifth time in a relentless pursuit of perfection. Each model has been sculpted anew from the ground up, not just refined but completely reimagined, forged to embody the dark essence of excess and corruption.

Crafted exclusively for 10mm and 15mm scale, these warriors march with razor-sharp clarity: every horn, every blade, every shard of armor sculpted to strike the eye and dominate the battlefield. Their forms are designed not only for visual impact, but also for flawless, effortless printing, ensuring their terror manifests cleanly on your tabletop.

This is more than a unit—it is the culmination of years of refinement, the fifth evolution of demonic might, perfected for wargamers who demand nothing less than the extraordinary.
